reviewIntro: Audition isolated positive-prompt stems. Automated quarantine catches excessive brightness, ringing, hum, clipping, and near-duplicate spectra before human review.
reviewNotice: Nothing is runtime-wired. EXCELLENT means a clean source stem, not an approved finished game sound.

assets.name: dig_soft_dirt_hit_satisfying_01
assets.objective: Build one dirt hit from three acoustically separate sources.
assets.listeningFor: Soft earth weight, damped contact, loose soil detail.
assets.rejectIf: Bright ringing, brittle shards, synthetic tone, or a sustained tail.

stems.title: Damp loam body
stems.prompt: Close Foley stem of compact damp loam compressing beneath a blunt weight. Soft low thud, dense earth body, brief settling.

stems.title: Damped pick contact
stems.prompt: Close Foley stem of a cloth-damped forged-iron pick contacting packed earth. Short rounded low-mid knock with immediate decay.

stems.title: Loose soil debris
stems.prompt: A small handful of soil crumbs and fine grains falls ten centimeters onto packed loam. Sparse irregular earth texture, close field recording.

assets.name: dig_stone_break_chunky_01
assets.objective: Build a chunky stone break without brittle household-material timbre.
assets.listeningFor: Dense fracture, irregular rock bodies, sparse angular debris.
assets.rejectIf: Thin ringing, polished chinks, synthetic resonance, or excessive brightness.

stems.title: Granite fault fracture
stems.prompt: Close Foley stem of a palm-sized granite block splitting along one fault. Dense low-mid fracture with a short physical decay.

stems.title: Granite chunk impacts
stems.prompt: Two fist-sized granite chunks knock together once at close range. Heavy irregular rock body, compact natural resonance.

stems.title: Angular stone chips
stems.prompt: Four angular stone chips scatter a short distance across rough rock and stop. Sparse uneven debris, close field recording.

assets.name: robot_step_dirt_light_02
assets.objective: Construct a small machine step from damped hardware and real soil.
assets.listeningFor: Small weight, cushioned plate contact, readable dirt compression.
assets.rejectIf: Sci-fi whine, sharp alloy ring, large stomp, or polished impact preset.

stems.title: Cushioned iron foot
stems.prompt: A palm-sized cast-iron foot plate cushioned with worn leather taps compacted soil. Damped low-mid contact, close Foley stem.

stems.title: Soil compression
stems.prompt: Compacted dry earth compresses under a small heavy object. Rounded soil thud followed by a brief grit crunch.

stems.title: Loose casing settle
stems.prompt: A loose riveted casing shifts once after a light landing. Short damped hardware knock with one irregular washer tick.

assets.name: hoverboard_boost_start_01
assets.objective: Construct a physical boost start without a generic electronic sweep.
assets.listeningFor: Fast air shove, dense mechanism kick, damped plate response.
assets.rejectIf: Tonal rise, turbine cliché, ringing sheet, or glossy science-fiction preset.

stems.title: Compressed air shove
stems.prompt: A compact leather air bladder releases one tight pulse backward. Fast physical shove with a short broad decay.

stems.title: Weighted flywheel kick
stems.prompt: A small weighted flywheel engages once inside a rugged field machine. Dense low-mid rotational kick, immediate mechanical stop.

stems.title: Damped lift plate
stems.prompt: A thin iron lift plate flexes once under sudden pressure. Damped plate body with a brief rough vibration.

assets.name: ui_confirm_positive_02
assets.objective: Create a warm tactile confirmation from miniature physical contacts.
assets.listeningFor: Readable attack, warm body, quick finish, friendly asymmetry.
assets.rejectIf: Cash-register character, pitched ping, brittle shard, or digital sheen.

stems.title: Slate tile seat
stems.prompt: A thumbnail slate tile seats into a shallow wooden socket. Small dry mineral contact with a warm low-mid body.

stems.title: Leather-covered detent
stems.prompt: A compact leather-covered brass detent closes once. Soft tactile catch with a restrained mechanical edge.

stems.title: Wooden spring button
stems.prompt: A tiny wooden button presses a short spring and settles. Friendly tactile confirmation with two unequal contacts.

assets.name: darkness_edge_creep_loop
assets.objective: Build a sparse natural cave-edge loop from independent air, dust, and room stems.
assets.listeningFor: Irregular quiet space, real rock air, sparse particles, seamless repetition.
assets.rejectIf: Steady tone, pulse, heartbeat pattern, machine bed, or dramatic wind.

stems.title: Limestone crack air
stems.prompt: Seamless six-second field-recording loop of faint air moving through a narrow limestone crack. Slow irregular pressure with ample quiet space.

stems.title: Sparse dust motion
stems.prompt: Seamless six-second close texture of sparse dust grains sliding across rough cave stone. Quiet uneven movement with long gaps.

stems.title: Rock-shaped room tone
stems.prompt: Seamless six-second underground room tone shaped by dense rock and a distant natural draft. Subtle low-mid air pressure, calm and irregular.

assets.name: void_gate_pulse_01
assets.objective: Build a strange inward pulse from physical pressure, grit, and stone.
assets.listeningFor: Inward motion, restrained weight, dry particles, quick decay.
assets.rejectIf: Electronic sweep, tonal drone, bright portal preset, or cinematic boom.

stems.title: Inward pressure fold
stems.prompt: A short inward air-pressure fold inside a cracked stone arch. Compact suction pulse with a soft low-mid body and fast decay.

stems.title: Directional lifting grit
stems.prompt: Loose grit lifts toward one point across rough stone, then falls back. Sparse directional grains, close physical texture.

stems.title: Stone slab flex
stems.prompt: A thick stone slab flexes inward by a few millimeters and settles. Dense mineral stress knock with restrained weight.

assets.name: darkness_torch_reacts_01
assets.objective: Build a subtle torch warning from natural flame, ember, and grip stems.
assets.listeningFor: Brief flame movement, tiny ember detail, quiet tactile warning.
assets.rejectIf: Horror sting, pitched effect, breath-like vocalization, or synthetic sweep.

stems.title: Flame pressure hush
stems.prompt: A small oil flame folds sideways for an instant under a narrow air-pressure change. Brief flame hush and soft recovery.

stems.title: Dry ember release
stems.prompt: Two dry embers release from a cloth wick and land nearby. Tiny irregular fire contacts with a natural short decay.

stems.title: Leather grip warning
stems.prompt: A worn leather torch grip creaks once under a tightening hand. Quiet close tactile warning with a low-mid body.
